svg.title: Technology atlas
svg.desc: A knowledge graph of the whole laboratory. The 17 repositories sit on an outer ring, grouped into five divisions. Every technology shared by three or more of them floats in the centre, joined by a line to each repository that uses it. The most shared are Python in 10 repositories, React in 7 repositories, Docker in 5 repositories.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.text: Every technology used by three or more repositories, joined to each repository that uses it.
